name: Regulations.gov API
known_limitations: Dockets and comments can identify regulatory evidence, but comments are not verified facts and agency-specific fields may vary or be unavailable.
source_owner: U.S. General Services Administration eRulemaking Program
automation_notes: Track dockets and documents by agency, posted date, search term, docket ID, and document type.
notes: Use alongside Federal Register records when proposed rules or notices require comment, attachment, or docket context. Phase 48 check confirmed v4 documents, comments, and dockets endpoints plus API-key and data-limitation caveats.
